meta.title: DeskPad for Brightline Insurance — claims desk proposal
meta.description: Sales deck for Brightline Insurance's 220-agent claims team: DeskPad puts policy, claim and chat in one window, with proof from Harbor Mutual, a rollout plan with price, and a dated pilot.

slides.eyebrow: Prepared for Brightline Insurance · Claims operations · 9 December 2026
slides.heading: How Brightline's agents can close 30% more claims a day
slides.lead: From 31 to 40 claims per agent, with the same 220 people.
slides.notes: Open on their team and their number. Do not name the product until slide 5.

slides.heading: A claims agent now juggles 11 apps, up from 4 in 2020
slides.lead: Source: Contact Centre Tooling Report 2026, 1,800 insurance agents.

slides.heading: Claims teams on one screen settle claims in a third less time
slides.left:
Copy and paste between apps.
Notes typed twice.
New hires take 9 weeks to ramp.
slides.right:
Policy, claim and chat side by side.
Notes logged once.
New hires ramp in 4 weeks.

slides.heading: Every Brightline claim fits in one window, start to payout
slides.lead: Policy, claim and customer chat, side by side.
slides.imageAlt: A single window for claim BL-58213 with policy, claim estimate and payout button, and the customer chat in three panes.

slides.heading: DeskPad reads your claims, policy and chat systems into one window
slides.body:
Connectors for Guidewire, Salesforce and Zendesk.
No migration: data stays where it is.
slides.aside: Agents switch apps 62% less in week one.

slides.heading: One DeskPad macro turns a 14-click payout into a single click
slides.code:
macro: approve_water_payout
when: claim.type == "water" and estimate < 10000
steps:
  - check: policy.water_cover
  - pay: estimate - policy.deductible
  - email: template "payout-sent"
  - log: "Payout approved by {agent}"

slides.heading: Every action logs its own audit note, so agents stop typing them
slides.body:
Notes are written from what the agent did, with time and reason.
Auditors read one timeline per claim.
slides.aside: 4 minutes saved per claim on notes alone.

slides.heading: Harbor Mutual's agents closed 35% more claims a day within 90 days

stats.label: Claims per agent per day, 31 to 42

slides.quote: Our agents stopped hunting for tabs and started talking to customers. The payout macro alone gave us back a full day a week.
slides.by: Marcus Lee, VP Claims, Harbor Mutual

slides.heading: Brightline goes live in six weeks for $103k a year
Start the 20-agent pilot on 6 January and count claims by February
slides.lead: Two weeks, water claims only, no contract until the numbers move.
slides.notes: Ask who will pick the 20 agents. That person is the pilot owner.
